name: Shiwoo
source:
Shiwoo is the stern and serious head of security on the Hesperides station. Despite his strict demeanor, he has a kind soul and cares deeply for his community, wanting to keep everyone safe and happy.

He seems to be struggling under the weight of something more than just his heavy workload.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/330388878/love-at-the-milky-way-diner/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
